Hi Alyssa — thanks for the clear context. Short answer: yes, we can support both approaches and co-terming. I sketched two practical options below and attached a short PDF and the raw price sheet for numbers.

Options (summary):
1) Voucher/top-up (fastest): one-off prepaid voucher for tokens; immediate add, pro-rated usage, invoice on purchase. No term change.
2) Staged commit (recommended for cost predictability): annualize the incremental commit (annual pricing) and co-term to 2027-03-31 with pro-rated credit for the remainder of the current period. This yields a discount compared to one-off top-ups.

Ballpark: for the ~ $120k incremental run-rate we can offer a ~10% uplift discount if the customer annualizes and signs an amendment. If you'd prefer a smaller finance impact we can smooth with a voucher + staged billing.

Attachments: [Attachment: proposed_uplift_options.pdf (PDF, 48KB)], [Attachment: price_breakdown.xlsx (Excel, 22KB)]

- Quick 20m call to confirm preferred path (I have availability tomorrow 10–11 PT)
- If you pick annualize + co-term, I'll draft an amendment and route to Kimberly for approval.

I'll also include a short template amendment for procurement so they can prepare the PO window.
